_: The options screen's Advanced section and what it leaves out (tools/optgen.py; docs/kit-base.md). advanced: [setting, group, label, tip, {step}]. hidden: in the .ini only.
advanced: Ergonomics the 50-round drum adds to her MG-43 copy.
How much faster the drum reloads (0.4: 40%; the Concussive animation is quick already, so 0 by default); it reloads on the move either way.
Seconds on her primary or secondary before her gun goes (a stratagem or a grenade never counts).
The most enemies in the fan that take its round (the nearest first).
How long its barrage lasts (Blue Archive: about 10 s; a restart applies it).
Seconds between its volleys across the fan.
Tracers in each of the fan's three sections (two outer, one inner) every volley.
Seconds between the tracers aimed at the enemies in the fan (a restart applies it).
Metres a second of its tracers (slower: their trails are seen; 0: the round's own).
A magazine she empties reloads at once, without a spare (not her own gun: its rounds are its supply).
Seconds before the reload passive works again for the same gun.
Metres: her head lower than this over her feet counts as crouched or prone.
